cx.parse: Output is JSON possibly followed by extra data: decode only the first object (json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode). Use models[] with visibility != 'hide'; order by priority ascending; supported_reasoning_levels lists valid efforts.

ag.parse: Skip the 'Fetching available models...' line; each following line is '<slug><TAB><label>'. Slug is the model id; the -low/-medium/-high suffix is the effort.

cc.parse: No model-list command. 'claude --help' only shows aliases (fable, opus, sonnet). Use the newest full model ids known to the assistant/vendor docs and confirm each with one minimal live ping.

tier_rules: standard = cheap/fast triage (cc: haiku, cx: *-luna low, ag: newest flash low).
effort = daily driver (cc: newest sonnet high, cx: newest *-sol medium, ag: newest flash medium).
deepthink = deliberate escalation (cc: newest opus high, cx: newest *-sol xhigh, ag: claude-sonnet-5-5 high while gemini pro absent).
ag.argon = explicit gemini-4-argon-medium alternative on A-7D; standard/effort/deepthink remain unchanged.
max/ultra efforts are explicit per-call overrides, never a default tier.
Never pick models with visibility 'hide'. Keep an effort only if the model lists it as supported.
instructions: 1. Run each sources[*].command (skip a peer whose CLI is absent) and read versions with '<cli> --version'.

2. Compare against profiles using tier_rules; present a diff of proposed changes to the user and wait for approval. Observations are evidence, not policy: never change packaged defaults without approval.

3. After approval update the manifest and packaged defaults together; review the linked adapter docs in update_targets for invocation or version changes: new values, a new revision (YYYY-MM-DD.N, also defaults_revision in model-defaults.toml), observed_at and observed_versions.
4. Run: python -m pytest -q tests/communication/adapters (test_model_profiles_manifest.py fails on any drift between this file, the toml and the documentation links).

5. Optional, ask first (uses a little quota): python -m tools.model_ping [profile_id ...] pings each profile once and checks WHICH model answered (cc: modelUsage, cx: session log, ag: CLI log). Report failures verbatim.
6. Do not commit, push or release unless the user asks. Answer the user in their language; keep internal text English.

7. Observations (2026-10-16): installed CLIs are claude 2.1.301, codex-cli 0.163.0, agy 1.4.0. codex debug models: gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-astra, gpt-6-sol, gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-*; agy models adds available gemini-4-argon-{low,medium,high} (ag.argon selects medium; standard/effort keep gemini-3.8-flash-*).
